about_the_game:
Beatdown City Survivors is a tense and exhilarating immersive sandbox survive-em-up that knocks the genre on its head! The city is a nightmarish playground of interactive elements, including gas to ignite, puddles to electrify, and cars to blow up. Find dozens of weapons, including pipes, pigeons, boots, and combine them to make bigger, better and funnier weapons! You'll need to make your ultimate build and manipulate every element possible to wipe out the gruesome zombies, mutants and blood- thirsty creatures lurking in the streets.

  • Immersive Survival! Experience time survival gameplay fused with immersive sim sandbox (lite) gameplay for the first time! Destroy the environment, mix elements, set traps, and use anything to build own play style.

  • Create wild weapon combos! Strap knives to slippers and shred hundreds of fiends or make a bazooka out of fireworks and a pipe to blow up everything in sight. Experiment to uncover fun new combos!

  • Fight for your life! Use a large array of distinct automated combos made of punches, kicks, uppercuts, drop kicks, ground slams and a whole lot more to fight your your way to safety.

  • Recruit and play as new survivors! Build your army with an eclectic group of fighters who all have their own attacks and specials. They include include martial arts masters, shouting socialites, cats, and even a high top wearing Shiba Inu.

  • Upgrade and Conquer! Unlock >100 weapons and passives to create the ultimate build! Earn cash during runs, and buy upgrades to increase your chance of survival. 

  • The City is Yours! Fight through the desolate streets of Times Square, a zoo filled with mutant animals, and dank subway tunnels filled with speeding trains and hidden terrors. Battle monstrous bosses including a cyborg wrestler, vampire bikers, an ice troll in yoga pants, and more!

This demo allows players to explore the 1st level of the game as well as the "base", which allows players to complete a limited set of missions, unlocking a few characters and beginning the permanent stat upgrade path (s). 

The demo will also be updated periodically.

Progress in the demo will carry over to the final game!

content_descriptors.notes: Beatdown City Survivors features cartoon blood, guts and dismemberment against pixel art zombies, mutants, rats, roaches and more.

Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 (64 bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i3-3210
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: DirectX 10 capable GPU
  • Storage: 1 GB available space

Recommended:

short_description: Punch a car so hard it EXPLODES! Dash through flaming gas to create a fire trail burning everything. Destroy a hydrant to douse out the fire. Beatdown City Survivors is an immersive sandbox meets survive-em-up with dynamic environments & outrageous lite weapon crafting & team building.
supported_languages: English, French, German, Spanish - Spain, Simplified Chinese
